name: mcp-deal-flow-signal
description: Startup engineering acceleration data for investors. Trending startups, sector search, per-startup signal profiles, funding-likelihood predictions, side-by-side comparisons, diligence dossiers, and scout scoring — derived from public GitHub activity across 15 sectors. Backed by the Startup Engineering Acceleration Dataset (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19650920) and a deterministic 4-class signal classifier.
